exchanges.name: lists the tools of a stdio server the workspace declares, with the tool's ui resource marker

files.server.sh:
read init
printf '%s\n' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"result":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{"tools":{},"resources":{}},"serverInfo":{"name":"scripted","version":"0"}}}'
read initialized
read request
printf '%s\n' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"result":{"tools":[{"name":"echo","description":"Echoes its text","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"text":{"type":"string"}}},"_meta":{"ui":{"resourceUri":"ui://app/echo"}}}]}}'

exchanges.name: calls a tool and returns the server's result

read request

exchanges.name: answers a fixed IO_ERROR message and not the server's own error text

files.server.sh:
read init
printf '%s\n' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"result":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{"tools":{},"resources":{}},"serverInfo":{"name":"scripted","version":"0"}}}'
read initialized
read request
printf '%s\n' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"error":{"code":-32601,"message":"Method not found"}}'
